title: ASUS Vivobook S16 (S3607)
shortDescription: Slim 16-inch laptop with Intel Core Ultra (Series 3) processors, an OLED or 2.5K display and a 70Wh battery.
description:
Vivobook S16 is a slim 16-inch all-rounder built around Intel Core Ultra processors with an NPU of up to 50 TOPS.

It offers FHD+ OLED or 2.5K display options, an IR camera with privacy shutter, a full keyboard with number pad and a 70Wh battery, and meets the US MIL-STD 810H durability standard.

Processor: Intel Core Ultra 9 Processor 386H 2.1 GHz (18MB Cache, up to 4.9 GHz, 16 cores, 16 Threads); Intel NPU up to 50TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 355 2.3 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.7 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel NPU up to 49TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 325 2.1 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.5 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel NPU up to 47TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 255H 2.0 GHz (24MB Cache, up to 5.1 GHz, 16 cores, 16 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 13TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 225H 1.7 GHz (18MB Cache, up to 4.9 GHz, 14 cores, 14 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 13TOPS
Intel Core 7 Processor 240H 2.5 GHz (24MB Cache, up to 5.2 GHz, 10 cores, 16 Threads)
Intel Core 5 Processor 210H 2.2 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.8 GHz, 8 cores, 12 Threads)
Intel Core i7-13620H Processor 2.4 GHz (24MB Cache, up to 4.9 GHz, 10 cores, 16 Threads)
Intel Core i5-13420H Processor 2.1 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.6 GHz, 8 cores, 12 Threads)
Neural Processor: Intel AI Boost NPU up to 13TOPS

Display: 40.64 cms (16), FHD+ (1920 x 1200) OLED 16:10 aspect ratio
FHD+ (1920 x 1200) 16:10 aspect ratio, 300nits, Glossy display
Anti-glare display, sRGB: 100%, 0.2ms response time, Refresh Rate:60Hz refresh rate, 1,000,000:1, 70% less harmful blue light

Storage: 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.
512GB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.

I/O Ports: 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C with support for display / power delivery (data speed up to 5Gbps)
2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A (data speed up to 5Gbps), 1x 3.5mm Combo Audio Jack

Input.Keyboard & Touchpad: Backlit Chiclet Keyboard with Num-key, 1.7mm Key-travel, Precision touchpad, With Copilot key
Input.Camera: FHD camera with IR function to support Windows Hello, With privacy shutter

Power Supply: TYPE-C, 65W AC Adapter, Output: 20V DC, 3.25A, 65W, Input: 100-240V AC 50/60Hz universal

TYPE-C, 68W AC Adapter, Output: 20V DC, 3.4A, 68W, Input: 100~240V AC 50/60Hz universal, *Whether a charger is included varies according to country, region and model. Please check with your local ASUS retailer for details.

Operating System: Windows 11 Home - ASUS recommends Windows 11 Pro for business, *Windows 11 Home is available only as the Single Language edition in selected markets. Learn more about Windows 11 Home Single language: https://support.microsoft.com/article/eaf060a6-3642-4612-6b75-b34e57a08abf, No preinstalled OS

Security: BIOS Booting User Password Protection, IR webcam with Windows Hello support
